summary: lists what answers, opens one session, reads the instrument's identity and closes the session

inputs.name: address
inputs.meaning: the address to open, or null to open the only instrument that answers

outputs.name: identified
outputs.meaning: true when an identity was read

outputs.name: identity
outputs.meaning: observed claims, one per field read: field, value, kind, tool

outputs.name: session_closed
outputs.meaning: true when the session it opened was closed again

outputs.name: error
outputs.meaning: the error contract a tool returned, unchanged

validity: an instrument whose tools list what answers and identify one session at a time

source.locus: its tools list_devices, open_session, identify and close_session

note: On recorded transcripts; no device was read (MP1).
